CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  DEVELOPMENT SERVICES DEPARTMENT
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  MEETING AGENDA
August 2, 2024, 7:00 P.M.
City Council Chambers – Ninth Floor
1 West Manchester Boulevard
----------------------------------------------------------------------
1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll Call.

3.  Communications from staff.

4.  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items. Persons wishing to address
  the Planning Commission on any item on the agenda other than a
  public hearing may do so at this time.

5.  Minute approval for July 3, 2024, Planning Commission meeting.

6.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A public hearing to consider an application by Steven Sohn for
  Special Use Permit No. 24-00013 (SUP24-00013) to allow outdoor
  dining for an existing approximately 21,500 square-foot grocery
  store that is part of an existing multiple-tenant commercial
  building on an approximately 1.92 acre, C-2 (General Commercial)
  zoned property at 209 West Arbor Vitae Street.

  Planning Commission Actions:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2024-087.
  2) Adopt the attached resolution approving SUP24-00013.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it
  is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions and modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6a Documents

7.  NON-PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. Design Review 24-00014 (DR24-00014) to allow the construction
  of a 630 square-foot addition to an existing multiple-tenant
  commercial building on an approximately 3,700 square-foot MU-1
  (TOD Mixed Use-1) zoned property at 472 South Market Street.

  Planning Commission Actions:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2024-073.
  2) Adopt the attached resolution approving DR24-00014.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it
  is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions and modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 7a Documents
   b. Design Review 24-00023 (DR24-00023) to allow  exterior
  alterations and an approximately 1,155 square-foot addition to
  an existing 5,388 square-foot, two-story commercial building on
  an approximately 13,874 square foot H-C (Historic Core) zoned
  property at 116 South Market Street.

  Planning Commission Actions:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2024-089.
  2) Adopt the attached resolution approving DR24-00023.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it
  is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions and modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 7b Documents

  c. A non-public hearing to consider an application by Real Estate
  Development Services Group for Vesting Tentative Tract Map No.
  84423 (VTTM-84423) to allow a new five-unit, two-and-one-half-
  story, townhome-style condominium on an approximately 8,006
  square-foot R-3 (Multiple-family Residential) zoned property at
  419 South Eucalyptus Avenue.

  Planning Commission Actions:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2021-081.
  2) Adopt the attached resolution approving VTTM-84423.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it
  is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions and modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 7c Documents

8.  Public Comments. Anyone wishing to address the Planning Commission
  on any matter within their jurisdiction and not elsewhere
  considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

9.  Commission Initiatives.

10.  Adjournment.

If you will require special accommodations, due to a disability, please
contact the Planning Division at (310) 412-5230, One Manchester
Boulevard, Fourth Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301. All
requests for special accommodations must be received 48 hours prior to
the day of the hearing(s).

"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información, favor de
llamar a este número (310) 412-5230."

In the event that the Planning Commission meeting of August 2, 2024, is
not held, or is concluded prior to a public hearing or other agenda item
being considered, the public hearing or non-public hearing agenda item
will automatically be continued to the next regular Planning Commission
meeting.

  2

  1 WEST MANCHESTER BOULEVARD
  INGLEWOOD, CA 90301

CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  PARKING AND TRAFFIC COMMISSION (PTC)
  One West Manchester Blvd., Inglewood, CA 90301
  City Hall Lobby Community Room A
  AUGUST 2024 MEETING MINUTES

A. OPENING CEREMONIES
1. Meeting was held at 7:00 pm (PST) in Community Room A located on the first floor on August 28, 2024.
2. Attendees included: Chairperson Barbara Hibler, Commissioner Richard Galindo, Commissioner Lois Hale,
  Parking and Traffic Department Diana Maximo, William Thompson and City Traffic Engineer Peter
  Puglese.
3. The Chairperson Barbara Hilber introduced Destinee Wesley the new Secretary for the Parking and Traffic
  Commission.
4. Commissioner Bret Roberts arrived at the dias at the hour of 7:03pm.

B. PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING AGENDA ITEM
1. There were no comments from persons wishing to address the Parking and Traffic Commission on any
  agenda item.

C. APPROVAL OF MINUTES
1. Approval of the Minutes for the Meeting held on August 28, 2024
a. The information appears on pages 3-6 of the Agenda for June 26, 2024. To view the agenda click on the
  link: https://www.cityofinglewood.org/AgendaCenter/ViewFile/Agenda/_07242024-4136
b. The first motion to accept was made by Commissioner Rudd and seconded by Commissioner Galindo. The
  motion was carried by the following roll call vote: Barbara Hibler, Richard Galindo, Louis Hale, Kip Rudd,
  Brett Roberts.

D. UNFINISHED BUSINESS
  1. None

2. NEW BUSINESS
  1. None

E. PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING OTHER MATTERS
  2. Speaker 1 (Juan C), residing at 947 E 56th Street, expressed concern about parking on his street,
  particularly during events.
  3. Speaker 2 (Name Unknown), residing at 11722 Crenshaw, spoke about the need for alley clean-ups and
  mentioned that parking tickets are not being issued during events.

F. CHAIRPERSON AND COMMISSIONERS REMARKS

  1.  Chairperson Barbara Hibler: None.
  2.  Commissioner Galindo: Noted that many traffic lights have waiting times exceeding three minutes.
  3.  Commissioner Rudd: Discussed the timing issues with traffic lights.
  4.  Commissioner Hale: Addressed the need for street cleaning after concerts near residential areas.
  5.  Commissioner Roberts: None.

  ANNOUNCEMENTS
